Recipe Nutrition Estimator

Paste ingredient lines, match them against a nutrition database, get macros per serving.

Estimates from typical per-100g values. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste one ingredient per line, e.g. "200g chicken breast" or "2 tbsp olive oil".
  2. Supported units: g, kg, oz, lb. Lines without an amount are assumed to be 100 g and flagged.
  3. Enter the number of servings the recipe makes.
  4. Click Estimate to see matched ingredients, totals, and per-serving macros.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which units are understood?

Grams (g), kilograms (kg), ounces (oz), and pounds (lb/lbs). A line like '2 cups flour' has no convertible unit and will be listed as unmatched.

How does ingredient matching work?

Each line is matched against the 42-food database by name. Unmatched lines are listed so you can fix the wording.

How accurate is the result?

It is an estimate from typical per-100g values. Unmatched ingredients are excluded from the totals, which the report shows.
